programme.title: Graveyard Carz S16 - "The Ice-Trey 200"
programme.desc: To celebrate the 200th episode of Graveyard Carz, Mark and the Ghoulz visit a private automotive museum!

programme.title: Graveyard Carz S16 - "Phoenix Rising"
programme.desc: Graveyard Carz was born of struggle, challenge, and the dream of resurrecting an impossible car–the legendary Phantom ‘Cuda!

programme.title: Supercar Showdown S2 - "Fuel Consumption"
programme.desc: The day has finally arrived; the rookies get to jump into the Shannons V8 Supercar. But will it be all they hoped for?

programme.title: Supercar Showdown S2 - "Semi Final"
programme.desc: Shannons Supercar Showdown is drawing to a close - but there are plenty of twists and turns still to come in our explosive semi final!

programme.title: Supercar Showdown S2 - "Grand Finale"
programme.desc: Who will take out the competition and win the ultimate prize in motorsport, a place on the starting grid at the Supercheap Auto Bathurst 1000?

programme.title: Geared Up S1 - "Pinky"
programme.desc: A pink, air-cooled, 1973 Porsche 911 RS is upgraded with a custom built engine, new paint, and new wheels and tires.

programme.title: Geared Up S1 - "Benzilla"
programme.desc: A slow and outdated 1959 Mercedes Benz 180 D is modified with a bargain budget to include new wheels and an American V8 muscle motor.

programme.title: Geared Up S1 - "The Track T"
programme.desc: A 1972 Ford Track T Roadster is incomplete and needs Titan Restorarion;s finishing touch with its flathead V8 engine.

programme.title: Our Auto Expert S1 - "Episode Three"
programme.desc: Nik unveils the bold Cadillac Escalade, while Mike praises the redesigned Nissan Rogue. Nik shares Alfa Romeo's rich 110-year legacy, then cruises in the Lexus LC500 with the top down.

programme.title: Our Auto Expert S1 - "Episode Four"
programme.desc: Nik tests the 2021 Toyota Land Cruiser. Mike explores the 2021 Kia Telluride. Nik showcases the 2021 Hyundai N Line. Witness Mercedes Benz AMG's pinnacle creation. Nik's blown away by the new Kia K5.

programme.title: Our Auto Expert S1 - "Episode Five"
programme.desc: Nik showcases Mercedes-Benz's screen innovation. Mike loves the 2021 Kia Seltos. They both enjoy driving cool cars like the 2021 Corvette Stingray. Nik praises the 2021 Toyota Venza Hybrid.

programme.title: MTB Heroes S3 - "New Zealand"
programme.desc: We meet one of the most famous MTB photographers in New Zealand and follow him during the biggest MTB competition in Rotorua.

programme.title: Inside Moto S1 - "Learning to win"
programme.desc: We discover 2 ways of achieving success: The wild talent of the young Jack Miller, and the perfectionist tenacity of Tito Rabat.

programme.title: Inside Moto S1 - "Dynasties: Like father like son"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 Dynasties: Like father like son
programme.desc: We witness Randy Mamola and Wayne Gardner’s reunion, along side their successors: their sons Dakota y Remy.

programme.title: Inside Moto S1 - "The thin line to success"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E03 The thin line to success
programme.desc: We'll walk the fine line to success: from Alberto Puig's life changing accident, to the astonishing sponsorship deal of the Laglisse Champions’ Squad.

programme.title: King of the Hammers: The Ultra4 Saga S1 - "To Hell and Back"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 To Hell and Back
programme.desc: Last year's champion, Erik Miller defends his title. While 2nd place finisher, Jason Scherer, will be one of the many top challengers aiming to beat him.

programme.title: King of the Hammers: The Ultra4 Saga S1 - "Finding the Line"
programme.desc: We follow Shannon Campbell, the first 3-time champion of the King of the Hammers. But his kids, also young drivers, push their dad to the brink of his limits.

programme.title: King of the Hammers: The Ultra4 Saga S1 - "Bringing Out The Big Guns"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E03 Bringing Out The Big Guns
programme.desc: It's mud, sweat, and gears as drivers battle it out in the toughest Ultra 4 race yet.

programme.title: Car Crews with Supercar Blondie S1 - "Los Angeles"
programme.desc: Supercar Blondie goes to Hollywood arriving in a million dollar V12 Ferrari. In the ‘City of Angels’ Alex is brought into contact with the Brotherhood of Racing, a community of drivers looking to create safe racing conditions for amateurs.

programme.title: Car Crews with Supercar Blondie S1 - "Houston"
programme.desc: Given special access to a 2 million dollar exclusive McClaren Senna, Supercar Blondie digs under the surface to uncover gang feuds in the SLAB (Slow, Low and Bangin’) community and meets up with legendary hip hop artists Slim Thug and Paul Wall.

programme.title: Car Crews with Supercar Blondie S1 - "Las Vegas"
programme.desc: Supercar Blondie arrives in Las Vegas in a million dollar Lamborghini SVJ roadster. Taken under the wing of Patrick, founder of the Junkyard Pirates, Alex is brought into the rat rod world - home to American mavericks and outsiders.

programme.title: Desert Racers S1 - "Mechanical Meltdown"
programme.desc: As fuel shortages and mechanical failures threaten to end their race, tensions rise. Will they overcome the chaos and keep the dream alive?

programme.title: Desert Racers S1 - "Dark of the Desert"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E05 Dark of the Desert
programme.desc: The pressure intensifies as the team pushes further into the Baja 1000. Mechanical failures, punctured tires, and navigational setbacks challenge their endurance.

programme.title: Endurance - 24 Hours at Spa S2 - "Staying out of trouble"
programme.sub-title: S02 : E01 Staying out of trouble
programme.desc: In this episode, we experience the beginning of the 2018 Total 24 Hours of Spa together with some of the most promising teams aiming for victory.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S1 - "Delhi to Manali"
programme.desc: On the verge of an epic roadtrip, Jonathan visits the shrine of the motorcycle God for providence and sidetracks to combat the all-woman unit of the Delhi police.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S1 - "Ladakh, the Mountain Adventure"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E04 Ladakh, the Mountain Adventure
programme.desc: Jonathan embarks on a two wheeled journey over the highest roads in the world, stopping in remote monasteries to learn the secrets of Buddhism’s warrior demons and track down a secreted manuscript rumored to explain the lost years of Jesus.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S1 - "The Land Of Kings Part 1"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E05 The Land Of Kings Part 1
programme.desc: From the pink city to the blue city, our host weaves his way through citadels, dunes and temples in this legendary frontierland of kings. He braves the rat temple in search of the lucky albino rodent and hears the epic of cow hearding Gods.

programme.title: Travel Quest S1 - "Madagascar"
programme.desc: The real Madagascar has no talking lions, zebras or hippos. What it does have is the most unique collection of plants and animals anywhere on earth. Bill fights the nearly inaccessible land to find a rare lemur that dances and another one that sings.

programme.title: Travel Quest S1 - "Mongolia"
programme.desc: There is nothing on earth that compares to Mongolia. Here the last nomadic people range their livestock over millions of acres of grasslands. Drinking fermented mare’s milk (worst tasting drink ever), riding a yak and finding the original wild horses

programme.title: Travel Quest S1 - "North Pole"
programme.desc: The crew takes an icebreaker to the North Pole just in time to make a satellite phone call to wish Bill's mother a happy birthday (she is so shocked she doesn't recognize him). We also track and film the biggest predators on earth…polar bears.

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S1 - "India: Can Kolkata be considered a foodie destination of India?"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E03 India: Can Kolkata be considered a foodie destination of India?
programme.desc: Liesel pinballs around a city known for its gastronomy, the forgotten hub of British East India trading company, Kolkata. From trying out what the bustling city’s vibrant street food scene has to offer, to the lesser known gems, including, venturing into India’s only Chinatown and sampling their delicacies. A tale of walking food tours, hole in the wall joints serving up North Eastern dumplings, messy fish markets, and of course, the pride of Bengal, the Hilsa fish. Is Kolkata up to par with the other major metropolitan cities of India? This episode finds out exactly that!

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S1 - "Nevada: What else is there in Nevada for foodies besides Vegas?"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E04 Nevada: What else is there in Nevada for foodies besides Vegas?
programme.desc: This investigative mission starts off in the sin city atmosphere of the Vegas strip. After a gluttonous stint at a generic buffet, Liesel is inspired to do a road trip to find iconic gems in the state of Nevada. From ghost towns, to monstrous foodie challenges, to hole in the wall dive bars in the middle of nowhere, this trip has it all. Liesel finds the resurgence of Basque cuisine in Northern Nevada, and learns that Reno can do fine dining as well! A trip to Virginia city also reveals that the Silver State has some haunted bars where patrons from the 1800s are rumored to be still imbibing and spooking locals! It’s a road trip in every sense of the word!

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S1 - "Rome: What are the tourists missing out on?"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E05 Rome: What are the tourists missing out on?
programme.desc: Italy is a vacationer’s paradise. The food, the people, the sights and sounds, the history! But are the tourists doing it right when it comes to the trying out authentic food in Rome? Liesel embarks on a mission to explore the street food of the city. With the help of her food journalist buddy, Saverio de Luca, Liesel sifts through pasticceri, food festivals, touristed hotspots, all in an effort to understand real Roman food.

programme.title: Travel Quest S1 - "Rwanda…Gorillas"
programme.desc: Bill tracks through never ending mud, heavy vegetation and steep mountains, to come face-to-face with our mighty cousins. He also traces the life, and finds the remnants, of the camp of one of his idols - Diane Fossey.

programme.title: Travel Quest S1 - "Botswana"
programme.desc: Botswana is a wildlife lover’s dream with massive herds of elephants, immense pods of hippos and some of the largest prides of lions anywhere. It’s also the home of Victoria Falls…the largest falls in the world.

programme.title: Travel Quest S1 - "New Zealand & Australia"
programme.desc: Bill has always been fascinated with the Americas Cup yacht racing – it’s as intense as the name implies. But the big adventure is riding in, and then flying, a Soviet Mig Jet doing stunts and mind numbing close fly-bys.

programme.title: Kindness Diaries S1 - "The Gift of Love"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 The Gift of Love
programme.desc: With a tank full of gas donated by a “would-be traveler”, Leon and Kindness One® leave LA and try their luck in Sin City before finding help from a Scotsman in an out of the way Western town in Colorado, inspires his first surprise gift.

programme.title: Kindness Diaries S1 - "The Gift of Security"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 The Gift of Security
programme.desc: Leon goes deep into working life on a cattle ranch in Nebraska – literally. Has bike trouble in Chicago, before being shunned by the Amish, but a chance encounter with a homeless man in Pittsburgh, leaves him transformed and inspires his next gift.

programme.title: Kindness Diaries S1 - "The Gift of Inspiration"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E03 The Gift of Inspiration
programme.desc: Leon finds refuge in the world’s toughest city, works his way across the Atlantic aboard a cargo ship. A Spanish customs issue threatens to derail his journey, and the music of two African musicians in southern France, inspires his next gift.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S1 - "The Land Of Kings Part 2"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E06 The Land Of Kings Part 2
programme.desc: On the darker side he evades guards and good advice by spending a night hidden in the ruins of Asia’s most haunted location, and travels through a jungle to find a witch living in a dilapidated mansion.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S1 - "The Spiritual Adventure"
programme.desc: Fleeing the hard monsoon rains, Jonathan seeks refuge with hot cups of java in the rolling hills of India’s coffee country and in the peaceful energy of India’s largest Tibetan community.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S1 - "Kerala Kaleidoscope"
programme.desc: Jonathan hangs out with a group of fisherman that utilizes the ancient Chinese fishing nets designed in the time of Kublai khan. He attends a Kathakali dance academy and gets ready for center stage with an elaborate 3 hour makeup process.

programme.title: Food Unknown S1 - "Russia"
programme.desc: Jonathan faces his toughest challenge yet as he enters a country that has been coming to grips in defining and understanding their own cuisine. Through the historical turmoil and harsh climate, Russia has lost it’s traditional way of cooking, and eating. But the country is reviving this culture; Jonathan ventures the far stretches of the country to learn about modern cooks, as well as ancient kitchens housing the one key tool that gave birth to true Russian cuisine, the Russian oven. He’ll learn their insights, understand their efforts, and work with traditional Russian ingredients to learn what the cuisine used to be, and where it’s headed today.

programme.title: Food Unknown S1 - "Mexico"
programme.desc: Jonathan Legg is from California and he thinks he knows Mexican cuisine. This notion gets shattered as he experiences the onslaught of food in Mexico city! Between trying scorpion tacos and dodging shady markets in San Juan, he learns the dark art of sacred drinks, like pulque and mezcal, now turned into social libations. His journey also takes him to Oaxaca where he gets the low down on the fabled Mole sauce, and a long haul to a remote village reveals a secret ceremony that has origins of dark arts!

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S1 - "Emlia Romagna: What’s the food like?"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E06 Emlia Romagna: What’s the food like?
programme.desc: The region of Emilia Romagna is lush with gentle rolling hills where time honored ingredients like truffles, olives, and vast vineyards can be found. But this region is usually overshadowed by it’s more famous neighboring cities, Florence and Venice. To understand the food of this region, Liesel explores the quaint sea-side town of Rimini and the hugely impressive Bologna. It's a tale of discovering local foodie passion that allows Liesel to hunt for truffles and try her hand in making her own gelato, a the world’s only Gelato University!

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S1 - "Mexico: Tequila: Does it need to come from certain regions of Mexico?"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E07 Mexico: Tequila: Does it need to come from certain regions of Mexico?
programme.desc: In the land of tequila, Liesel gets the skinny on the premium export of Jalisco, blue agave tequila. From harvesting agave with the legendary jimadores, to understanding the process of distillation, Liesel is on the hunt to appreciate and understand the production requirements of this spirit that makes it what it is. Are they worth it only if they’re from Jalisco or can they be made somewhere else for cheaper and better..? Liesel finds out!

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S1 - "Los Angeles: Food trucks: are they any good?"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E08 Los Angeles: Food trucks: are they any good?
programme.desc: It’s a well known fact that Los Angeles is the trendsetter for entertainment, fashion, and outlandish celebrity exploits. But is it the same story with the food? Liesel explores the food truck bubble to figure out what started the craze, why it's so popular, and more importantly, is the food any good?

programme.title: Travel Quest S1 - "Kenya's Great Grasslands"
programme.desc: Bicycling is a safe and leisurely activity, until you decide to do it through the wilderness of Kenya with large lion, elephant and buffalo populations.

programme.title: Travel Quest S1 - "Wild Indonesia"
programme.desc: Bill had two wild icons he wanted to experience. The first is the largest lizard in the world - the Komodo Dragon. Walking among these massive beasts was unnerving to say the least. The other is Asia's one ape - the orangutan.

programme.title: Travel Quest S2 - "Cultural Indonesia"
programme.desc: Of all bucket list items, one stands out above the rest—seeing one of the original reasons for starting the UNESCO World Heritage sites—the massive temple of Borobudur.

programme.title: Epic Trails S1 - "Peru"
programme.desc: Eric Hanson explores the amazing culture, hikes, and ruins of Peru’s Sacred Valley.

programme.title: Epic Trails S1 - "Winter in Banff & Lake Louise"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E06 Winter in Banff & Lake Louise
programme.desc: Eric Hanson returns to Banff National Park and Lake Louise in the snowy months to explore the backcountry by snowshoe and snowboard.

programme.title: Epic Trails S1 - "The Jordan Trail"
programme.desc: Eric Hanson heads to Jordan to explore the newly developed ‘Jordan Trail’—a 450-mile hiking trail that crosses the country and passes through some of the world’s most inspiring landscapes and historical sites, including the ancient city of Petra.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S1 - "Season 1 “Best of”"
programme.desc: Jonathan is back in India to host a special episode which explores his vast archive of experiences throughout India. Jonathan also reveals an exclusive insight into the inner workings of the show, how everything is put together and behind the scenes.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S2 - "Amsterdam to Morocco"
programme.desc: Jonathan starts off the season by exploring Dutch curiosities, and then hops on the world's largest cargo ship enroute for Morocco, where a whole new adventure starts

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S2 - "Mumbai"
programme.desc: Mumbai's rag to riches story is experienced in the entire spectrum; Bollywood roles, a stay at Taj Palace, and an indepth tour of Dharavi slums, oh and dont' forget a spot of rat hunting!

programme.title: Kindness Diaries S1 - "The Gift of Transformation"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E04 The Gift of Transformation
programme.desc: After striking out in St. Tropez, and getting lost in the Italian countryside, Leon finds shelter in 18th Century villa outside Torino, but his luck runs out on the shores of Lake Como.

programme.title: Kindness Diaries S1 - "The Gift of Abundance"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E05 The Gift of Abundance
programme.desc: After catching some waves in Zagreb and touring the turbulent history of Sarajevo, Leon and Kindness One® make it to Montenegro, where a kind farmer whose family has been tilling the same land for 20 generations inspires his next surprise gift.

programme.title: Kindness Diaries S1 - "The Gift of Service"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E06 The Gift of Service
programme.desc: In Kosovo, Leon meets a Muslim woman who dreams of peace, and some bike trouble in Greece opens the door for adventure. Finally, some high-altitude hospitality in Turkey inspires his next surprise gift.

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S1 - "Indonesia - Balinese cuisine: what is it all about?"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E09 Indonesia - Balinese cuisine: what is it all about?
programme.desc: Balinese cuisine is considered to be extremely complex. Different than what you find in the rest of Indonesia, Bali is further influenced by the major influx of Western tourism. Have the locals kept their traditions and cooking methods strong against the wave of tourism, or have they been catered to suit the palates of foreigners? Liesel heads to the ultimate getaway paradise island, sifts through all the yoga retreats, surfer shacks, and coffee plantations all in an effort to find iconic food - as well as track down the current foodie trend of the island.

programme.title: Travel Quest S2 - "New South Wales, Australia"
programme.sub-title: S02 : E02 New South Wales, Australia
programme.desc: South Wales is home to Sydney and its fabled Opera House and Harbor Bridge. Bill attempts to climb the giant steel structure to get a better view of the city.

programme.title: Travel Quest S2 - "Siberia & Mongolia"
programme.desc: This episode literally takes you to some of the world’s remotest places. First, a visit to Siberia…one of the most foreboding places on earth and yet we learn many of the stories are just myths.

programme.title: Epic Trails S2 - "Papua New Guinea"
programme.desc: Eric Hanson visits wild and remote villages in Papua New Guinea, as he challenges himself on one of the world’s most difficult trails—the Kokoda Track.

programme.title: Epic Trails S2 - "Canada’s Sunshine Coast, BC"
programme.sub-title: S02 : E02 Canada’s Sunshine Coast, BC
programme.desc: Eric Hanson heads to British Columbia’s beautiful Sunshine Coast, to explore the 112-mile long Sunshine Coast Trail and to test his nerves at the Coast Gravity Downhill Mountain Bike Park.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S2 - "Thailand"
programme.desc: Muay Thai, river festivals, tourist scams and mahouts! This is a look at Thailand the Road less Traveled way

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S2 - "Indonesia"
programme.desc: Jonathan is exploring the fringes of Indonesia; black magicians, semi active volcanoes and sulphur spewing lakes!

programme.title: Kindness Diaries S1 - "The Gift of Tomorrow"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E07 The Gift of Tomorrow
programme.desc: Leon receives an honored blessing on his journey. In Ephesus, Leon walks in the footsteps of Apostle Paul, before escalating Middle-East conflicts threaten his journey.

programme.title: Kindness Diaries S1 - "The Gift of Education"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E08 The Gift of Education
programme.desc: Leon and Kindness One® tour the world’s most famous monument to love, the Taj Mahal, before their journey hits a wall – literally. And after a hard day’s work on an Indian Farm, Leon travels to The City of Fire.

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S1 - "Ireland - Dublin, what else is there besides the pub culture"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E10 Ireland - Dublin, what else is there besides the pub culture
programme.desc: Admit it, first thing you relate with Dublin are the pubs. Sure, they are a staple and they serve some of the best brews in the world. And they come with an associated culture that is hard to rival. But what about the food? Does Dublin have a burgeoning foodie scene or is it all about the pint o’ Guiness? Find out on this episode of Max Foodie as Liesel explores the breathtakingly beautiful country of Ireland.

programme.title: Travel Quest S2 - "Philippines"
programme.desc: The Philippines is an incredible destination with countless World War II reminders and memorials, historic connections back to Magellan and a happy, friendly people.

programme.title: Travel Quest S2 - "Brazil’s Pantanal"
programme.desc: There may be no place on earth so rich in wildlife as Brazil’s Pantanal. In this Quest, Bill is going to track some of the rainforest creatures he’s always wanted to see.

programme.title: Travel Quest S2 - "Cultural Rwanda"
programme.desc: They say time heals all wounds, but can it heal the most horrific of all—genocide. On this Quest, Bill returns to Rwanda to see the post-war healing happening in this small, but globally significant country.

programme.title: Epic Trails S2 - "Peak District & Derbyshire"
programme.desc: Eric Hanson heads to the Peak District in England, to tackle the 268-mile Pennine Way—Britain’s oldest and most challenging National Trail.

programme.title: Epic Trails S2 - "Juneau, Alaska"
programme.desc: Eric Hanson heads deep into the backcountry to explore the mountains, glaciers and wildlife around Alaska’s capital city of Juneau.

programme.title: Epic Trails S2 - "Jämtland, Sweden"
programme.desc: Eric Hanson heads 63 degrees north to Jämtland, Sweden, where he discovers a wild culture and breathtaking wilderness trails.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S2 - "California"
programme.desc: Jonathan showcases what makes his state the best to enjoy all the outdoor activities; trackdayss, paragliding, swimming; the exploration at San Francisco and winds all the way down South to Los Angeles

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S2 - "Philippines P1"
programme.desc: Back in Asia, Jonathan embarks on a walking tour to explore all the intricacies of Manila; a tour that ends up with meeting Manny Pacquiao!

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S2 - "Philippines P2"
programme.desc: Jonathan tracks down cases of mysticism and locale lore; to contrast the macabre, he decides to host his own beauty pageant in the town of Iloilo

programme.title: Kindness Diaries S1 - "The Gift of Joy"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E09 The Gift of Joy
programme.desc: Leon is potentially stranded, when Kindness One® suffers a major breakdown in Patna. Later, he fulfills every Englishman’s dream in Darjeeling before he travels to Bhutan, to experience “Gross National Happiness” in action.

programme.title: Kindness Diaries S1 - "The Gift of Protection"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E10 The Gift of Protection
programme.desc: Leon and Kindness One® are forced to take the long way around to get to Thailand, but still manage to dive head first into their adventure. In Cambodia, Leon fulfills a childhood dream when he visits the ancient Temple of Angkor Wat.

programme.title: Kindness Diaries S1 - "The Gift of Sight"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E11 The Gift of Sight
programme.desc: A visit to The Killing Fields of Cambodia is a harsh reminder of humanities darker side. In Ho Chi Minh City, Leon experiences the modernization of Vietnam. And while searching for food, Leon serendipitously meets a woman who opens his eyes.

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S2 - "Hong Kong - Michelin Madness part 1"
programme.sub-title: S02 : E01 Hong Kong - Michelin Madness part 1
programme.desc: Big money, big city vibes; Hong Kong houses the world’s highest number of millionaires and it’s something that’s not lost on you as you venture to Asia’s world city. In this episode, Sashi is on a quest to understand how Michelin rates and assesses the sheer depth of eateries in this metropolis. He will meet the top chefs of the city and understand their psyche, their trials and tribulations as they climbed their way to the top of the restaurant industry with 3 Michelin stars. But it's not all high brow cuisine, Sashi will also dive deep into the old school neighborhoods, sampling the local fare and seek out how Michelin is rating Asia’s sheer depth of eateries

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S2 - "Hong Kong - Michelin Madness part 2"
programme.sub-title: S02 : E02 Hong Kong - Michelin Madness part 2
programme.desc: Big money, big city vibes; Hong Kong houses the world’s highest number of millionaires and it’s something that’s not lost on you as you venture to Asia’s world city. In this episode, Sashi is on a quest to understand how Michelin rates and assesses the sheer depth of eateries in this metropolis. He will meet the top chefs of the city and understand their psyche, their trials and tribulations as they climbed their way to the top of the restaurant industry with 3 Michelin stars. But it's not all high brow cuisine, Sashi will also dive deep into the old school neighborhoods, sampling the local fare and seek out how Michelin is rating Asia’s sheer depth of eateries.

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S2 - "Philippines - More fun in the Philippines part 1"
programme.sub-title: S02 : E03 Philippines - More fun in the Philippines part 1
programme.desc: The story of cacao is more akin to South America, but in this episode, Sashi tracks the story of cacao in the Philippines, the entry point of cacao in Asia. With his friend, Spanish chef, Chele Gonzalez, they embark on an anthropological exploration tracing how the ancestral varietal cacao (crillio) came to be in the Philippine islands. Visiting farms to mystical islands, to top kitchens in Manila, this is the ‘never-before-told’ tale of cacao in the Philippine islands.

programme.title: Travel Quest S2 - "Australia Top to Bottom"
programme.sub-title: S02 : E07 Australia Top to Bottom
programme.desc: Australia is a giant country with diverse ecosystems that make it one of the most interesting in the world. This episode of Travel Quest explores the north and far south of this country…the world’s biggest “island”.

programme.title: Travel Quest S2 - "Polar Bears"
programme.desc: There is one place in the world where the mighty polar bear—largest carnivore on earth—can be found in large numbers during a very specific time of the year…Churchill Manitoba, Canada.

programme.title: Travel Quest S2 - "Namibia"
programme.desc: Bill has a dual quest—the first to visit one of the greatest deserts in the world and find out how the creatures and plants survive. The other is a bit unorthodox and maybe unbelievable – he’s going to seek, and hopefully find, the mythical unicorn.

programme.title: Epic Trails S2 - "Wales"
programme.desc: Eric Hanson heads to the UK to explore the rugged Wales Coast Path—an 870-mile hiking trail that offers stunning views and adventure along one of the most dramatic coastlines in the world.

programme.title: Epic Trails S2 - "Newfoundland & Labrador, Canada"
programme.desc: Eric Hanson travels to the far eastern edge of North America to discover the beauty of Newfoundland and explore the stunning East Coast Trail.

programme.title: Epic Trails S2 - "New South Wales, Australia"
programme.sub-title: S02 : E08 New South Wales, Australia
programme.desc: Eric Hanson heads down under and puts his outdoor skills to the ultimate test as he challenges rugged mountain trails during spectacularly bad weather in New South Wales, Australia.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S2 - "Malaysia"
programme.desc: Jonathan chances upon a shoe-dating marketing campaign and heads out on 3 unique dates to explore KL. Later, he comes across a unique situation deep in Sarawak

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S2 - "Vietnam"
programme.desc: Jonathan is pinballing around Hanoi, exploring fables, eating exotic foods, and helping MAG international remove unexploded ordinance

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S2 - "Japan"
programme.desc: In the world’s most populous city, Jonathan embarks on a quest to understand the new social dynamics of a modern society.

programme.title: Kindness Diaries S1 - "The Gift of Loyalty"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E12 The Gift of Loyalty
programme.desc: Leon and Kindness One® earn their sea legs one last time traveling, via cargo ship, from Asia to Vancouver, where they are greeted by a majestic wilderness and a bitter cold front.

programme.title: Kindness Diaries S1 - "The Gift of Gratitude"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E13 The Gift of Gratitude
programme.desc: On the last leg of their 25K mile global adventure, Leon and Kindness One® travel down the Pacific Coast on their way to Hollywood. Reflections of his favorite moments inspire Leon to meet up again with the first person to show him kindness.

programme.title: Kindness Diaries S2 - "The Gift of Faith"
programme.sub-title: S02 : E01 The Gift of Faith
programme.desc: Leon and Kindness 2 leave sunny Los Angeles and head to freezing Alaska. With no money or food a Canadian bushman comes to the rescue.

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S2 - "Philippines - More fun in the Philippines part 2"
programme.sub-title: S02 : E04 Philippines - More fun in the Philippines part 2
programme.desc: The story of cacao is more akin to South America, but in this episode, Sashi tracks the story of cacao in the Philippines, the entry point of cacao in Asia. With his friend, Spanish chef, Chele Gonzalez, they embark on an anthropological exploration tracing how the ancestral varietal cacao (crillio) came to be in the Philippine islands. Visiting farms to mystical islands, to top kitchens in Manila, this is the ‘never-before-told’ tale of cacao in the Philippine islands.

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S2 - "Vietnam - Heart of Hanoi part 1"
programme.sub-title: S02 : E05 Vietnam - Heart of Hanoi part 1
programme.desc: Vietnam offers travelers a wide range of exotic as well as simple homegrown grub. Sashi rolls into town with no knowledge of Vietnamese cuisine, and he gets an indepth street food 101 tour of the city. From learning about haute Franco-Vietnamese cuisine with the city’s best French chefs, to a simple and honest bowl of pho. In this episode, Sashi uncovers the bustling city of Hanoi and all its trappings. Secret alleyways leading to decades old cafes offering famous brews like egg coffee; to iconic places that serve French style baguettes and everything in between!

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S2 - "Vietnam - Heart of Hanoi part 2"
programme.sub-title: S02 : E06 Vietnam - Heart of Hanoi part 2
programme.desc: Vietnam offers travelers a wide range of exotic as well as simple homegrown grub. Sashi rolls into town with no knowledge of Vietnamese cuisine, and he gets an indepth street food 101 tour of the city. From learning about haute Franco-Vietnamese cuisine with the city’s best French chefs, to a simple and honest bowl of pho. In this episode, Sashi uncovers the bustling city of Hanoi and all its trappings. Secret alleyways leading to decades old cafes offering famous brews like egg coffee; to iconic places that serve French style baguettes and everything in between!

programme.title: Travel Quest S2 - "Palau & Guam"
programme.desc: Exploring the islands of Palau and Guam includes a submarine view of the ocean wildlife, exploration of the battles of World War II, learning the culture of the locals and snorkeling among thousands of jellyfish.

programme.title: Travel Quest S2 - "Panama"
programme.desc: There is probably no country in the world that has more to do with world commerce than Panama. But Panama is more than just the canal—it’s a haven for wildlife.

programme.desc: Deputies confront an intoxicated man who threatened a restaurant owner. A man tells officers he can assault who he wants. Officers are called to an altercation over a sleeping bag and a backpack.

programme.title: Cops
programme.desc: A man runs from Police over a parole violation. Officers respond when a trouble maker is expelled from a bar for bad behavior. Police pursue a man after he bails from his car during a traffic stop.

programme.title: Cops
programme.desc: Officers engage in a high-speed pursuit of a stolen vehicle. Police spot a motel fire, alert the guests and contact the Fire Department. Officers pursue a suspect on a stolen motorcycle.

programme.sub-title: S13 : E19 One for the Road
programme.desc: A man crashes his vehicle after losing control while attempting to evade the police. An elderly woman with an outstanding DUI warrant is arrested for hit and run. Officers discover methamphetamine while investigating two suspicious vehicles on the side of the road.

programme.title: Cops

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Dårlige bremser, slidte nerver og en dårlig vej, får Claudia til at tvivle på, om teamet kan få transporteret deres store barak til lejren i ét stykke.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Efter at have mistet to ugers minedrift til skovbrandene, vender Claudia og Robin tilbage til Two Mile og satser på at åbne en ny pit.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Claudia kæmper for at få deres bedste jade klar til køberne, mens teamets moral bliver testet af kulden da de starter på at skære den 90-tons stenblok i stykker.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Claudia presser sit mandskab til at fortsætte minedriften på trods af frysende temperaturer og forfærdelige vejforhold.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Claudias sæson starter forrygende, da hun modtager en jadeordre på 250.000 dollars.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Efter at blive snydt af Scrappy Larry i årevis, er det Robins tur til at narre hans gamle ven.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Under pres for at opfylde deres købers stramme tidsfrist, kommer Robin og Josh op og toppes, da de støder på endeløse problemer med saven.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Josh undgår med nød og næppe en katastrofe, da han kører ind i minen med brændstof, og Claudia bliver knust, da en jadesten flækker i to, mens hun skærer den.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Claudia og Robin kæmper for at finde en anden jadesten, før deres køber dropper aftalen, men de løber tør for tid og muligheder.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Claudia søger hjælp fra sin far Steve, da hun frygter, at det største salg i hendes minekarriere ender galt.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Spændingerne koger over mellem Claudia, Robin og Josh, da de gør et sidste forsøg på at afslutte en aftale med en køber fra Vietnam.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Flytningen af en massiv jadesten tester minens gamle udstyr og Joshs' tålmodighed.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Da et usædvanligt snevejr i august efterlader Claudia og Robin ved Two Mile, forsøger Gary og Garon at redde dagen ved at køre igennem stormen for at bringe dem forsyninger.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Robin træffer en svær beslutning om hans elskede minelastbil 6-Pack efter endnu en dyrt sammenbrud.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Med vinteren lige om hjørnet presser Claudia sit udmattede team til bristepunktet, hvilket får temperamenterne til at blusse op og tvinger Claudia til endelig at tage en for holdet.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Den nye minesæson er fyldt med grimme overraskelser, men en uventet hændelse redder dagen.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Træt af at arbejde for sin far, starter Josh sin egen transportvirksomhed med en ny lastbil.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Militærlastbilen går i stå på den frygtelige vej til minen.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Gary og sønnen finder en gammel militærlastbil, men det er hårdt at køre den op til minen.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Garon og Josh mister kontrollen over Six Pack på de mudrede stier.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Justin flyver ind med en ny sav, men mister tålmodigheden, da han forsøger at sætte den op.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Claudia ankommer med boreudstyr og har kun fire dage til at finde den bedste jade, men Robin og hende kan ikke blive enige om, hvor de skal lede.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Drengene kommer op og skændes, da tidspresset tvinger dem til at arbejde på to miner på én gang.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Teamet får jadesten op af J-linsen, men problemer med vejen truer hele operationen.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: At trække en 20-tons stenblok ud af minen viser sig at være for meget for deres gamle lastbil 6-Pack.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy

To start, Michael stays light with an airy Mortadella Mousse spread on fluffy Modena Mini Flatbreads. Next, Michael cooks up Tortellini in Broth, a dish originally from Bologna that can be easily altered to personal taste. Michael chooses to fill his tortellini with a rich and savoury mixture of prosciutto, mortadella, and ground pork. For his secondo, Michael uses traditional ingredients and pairs them in a tart, luxurious dish of Duck Breast with Balsamic Cherry Sauce. To wind down his meal, Michael whips up a creamy classic, Rice Custard Cake topped with a Cherry Glaze.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy

Full of sweet, savoury, and spicy flavours, this dish provides a strong, flavourful meal sure to please any crowd. For his secondo, Michael goes for a hearty Lamb au Gratin with Peas and Asparagus; a classic holiday dish that will warm any room. For his finale, Michael whips up a simple, yet impressive, Chocolate-covered Figs.

programme.title: Food Unknown S1 - "Philippines"
programme.desc: The nation of 7,000 islands has no problems with beach, sun, or sea; but they suffer tremendously with cuisine image. Jonathan lands in Manila to discover the top chefs are well aware of the issue and, following their advice, he launches off on an expedition to find part of the solution. Driving from headhunting tribal villages, to step-back-in-time colonial towns, to restaurants in the shadow of the American military behemoth an intriguing story slowly pieces together. In the dense jungle one treasure stays buried while another comes literally out of the woodwork. But danger always lurks.. zombie moray eels, landslide prone passes, and forbidden fields behind the rice paddies.

programme.title: Food Unknown S1 - "Finland"
programme.desc: Finland is that one Nordic country that is never on the global cuisine radar. However, the reserved Finns have been quietly perfecting their craft of foraging culture and incorporating it into their unique cuisine. Jonathan Legg explores the entire expanse of the country to understand it’s cuisine, and the ethos of the country’s top chefs; from amazing locally sourced cuisine in Helsinki, to an expedition in Lapland to learn about foraging and the Finnish delicacy, reindeer!

programme.title: The Streets S1 - "Las Vegas"

programme.title: Quyang Stone Carving
programme.desc: Quyang is known as a hometown of Chinese carving. Quyang's stone carving works are popular around different parts of China, thus also exported to over 100 countries and regions worldwide. The style of Quyang stone carving both carries the mysterious and rough spirit of the Wei Dynasty and the natural and graceful forms of the Tang and Song dynasties. It reflects the life experiences and live philosophies of local artisans. Each statue's showcases unique oriental aesthetics.

programme.title: Nanjing Yunjin Brocade: A Traditional Chinese Silk Craft
programme.desc: Nanjing Yunjin Brocade, a traditional Chinese silk handicraft with a history spanning over 1,600 years, derives its name from its radiant and resplendent hues, which resemble clouds in the sky. Renowned for its exquisite materials, meticulous weaving techniques, and vibrant, splendid patterns, Yunjin Brocade is hailed as the "king of brocades." It represents the pinnacle of Chinese silk weaving techniques, encapsulates the essence of Chinese silk craftsmanship, and stands as a brilliant crystallization of China’s silk culture. The core technique of Yunjin Brocade weaving—known as "weaving through the warp and cutting the weft"—is executed manually by two artisans working above and below...

programme.title: Diabolo
programme.desc: In China, the diabolo has a history of over 600 years. From the earliest uniaxial design, it developed to have a double axis. With time, it came to be made in various shapes and from various materials. And its popularity began to spread around the world. In the hands of an expert, a diabolo can create a truly mesmerizing spectacle. So, let’s hear from a professional about the various tricks of his trade.

programme.title: The Tongliang Dragon Dance
programme.desc: The Tongliang Dragon Dance is a traditional performance art rooted in Chongqing’s Tongliang District, characterized by its elaborate dragon props and dynamic choreography. Originating in the Ming Dynasty and flourishing during the Qing, this vibrant folk tradition has regained its brilliance in modern times and earned international acclaim. The dance consists of two main branches: the dragon lantern dance—featuring forms like the Grand Wriggling Dragon, the Fire Dragon, and the Straw Dragon—and the festive lantern dance, which includes acts such as “Carp Leaps Over the Dragon Gate,” “Mudfish Eating Dumplings,” and “Three Dragons.” Steeped in cultural symbolism, the Tongliang Dragon Dance...

programme.title: Quyang Stone Carving
programme.desc: Quyang is known as a hometown of Chinese carving. Quyang's stone carving works are popular around different parts of China, thus also exported to over 100 countries and regions worldwide. The style of Quyang stone carving both carries the mysterious and rough spirit of the Wei Dynasty and the natural and graceful forms of the Tang and Song dynasties. It reflects the life experiences and live philosophies of local artisans. Each statue's showcases unique oriental aesthetics.

programme.title: Nanjing Yunjin Brocade: A Traditional Chinese Silk Craft
programme.desc: Nanjing Yunjin Brocade, a traditional Chinese silk handicraft with a history spanning over 1,600 years, derives its name from its radiant and resplendent hues, which resemble clouds in the sky. Renowned for its exquisite materials, meticulous weaving techniques, and vibrant, splendid patterns, Yunjin Brocade is hailed as the "king of brocades." It represents the pinnacle of Chinese silk weaving techniques, encapsulates the essence of Chinese silk craftsmanship, and stands as a brilliant crystallization of China’s silk culture. The core technique of Yunjin Brocade weaving—known as "weaving through the warp and cutting the weft"—is executed manually by two artisans working above and below...

programme.title: Diabolo
programme.desc: In China, the diabolo has a history of over 600 years. From the earliest uniaxial design, it developed to have a double axis. With time, it came to be made in various shapes and from various materials. And its popularity began to spread around the world. In the hands of an expert, a diabolo can create a truly mesmerizing spectacle. So, let’s hear from a professional about the various tricks of his trade.

programme.title: The Tongliang Dragon Dance
programme.desc: The Tongliang Dragon Dance is a traditional performance art rooted in Chongqing’s Tongliang District, characterized by its elaborate dragon props and dynamic choreography. Originating in the Ming Dynasty and flourishing during the Qing, this vibrant folk tradition has regained its brilliance in modern times and earned international acclaim. The dance consists of two main branches: the dragon lantern dance—featuring forms like the Grand Wriggling Dragon, the Fire Dragon, and the Straw Dragon—and the festive lantern dance, which includes acts such as “Carp Leaps Over the Dragon Gate,” “Mudfish Eating Dumplings,” and “Three Dragons.” Steeped in cultural symbolism, the Tongliang Dragon Dance...

programme.title: Nyingchi Ep.1
programme.desc: Join Tianran He in Nyingchi, Xizang Autonomous Region. Fed by the Yarlung Zangbo River and abundant rainfall, this lush subtropical region is home to some of Xizan’g most unique scenery. From sacred mountains and ancient monasteries, to cruising along Nyingchi’s mother river, wandering alpine meadows and savoring stone pot chicken – a beloved local delicacy, Tianran uncovers the beauty of Nyingchi.

programme.title: Nyingchi Ep.2
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He continues his journey through Nyingchi, Xizang Autonomous Region. programme.title: Nyingchi Ep.3
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He rounds off his travels through Nyingchi, Xizang Autonomous Region. He journeys into the Yarlung Zangbo Grand Canyon – one of the largest and deepest canyons on Earth, and along the way, tries to catch a glimpse of Mount Namcha Barwa, the easternmost peak of the Himalayas. Instead, he encounters a waterfall said to be a gateway to the afterlife, before finally arriving at the entrance to the canyon.

programme.title: Wenzhou
programme.desc: Tianran He is in Wenzhou, southeast China — a city famed for its self-made millionaires. Here he meets the first Chinese shoemaker to expand overseas, and hears the stories of other local entrepreneurs. Along the way, he samples traditional snacks, visits some of China’s oldest lighthouses, and enjoys an evening of Ou Opera. He also learns the craft of papermaking, before heading into the hills to soak in hot springs and wander across ancient covered bridges.

programme.title: Outkirts of Wenzhou

programme.title: Jingmai Wanderings: A Symphony of Humans and Tea
programme.desc: As a UNESCO World Heritage site, Mount Jingmai embodies the ecological wisdom of forest–tea symbiosis and the rich cultural diversity of its ethnic communities. It plays a vital role in biodiversity conservation and the preservation of traditional tea culture.This episode follows the stories of representative individuals to explore three key themes — heritage preservation, ecological sustainability, and youth empowerment — revealing the unique charm and sustainable development model of Mount Jingmai.

programme.title: Suzhou Fans

programme.title: Yangliuqing New Year Painting Art
programme.desc: On May 20, 2006, Yangliuqing New Year Paintings were named as part of China’s national intangible cultural heritage. The New Year painting tradition can be traced back many centuries, to the Ming Dynasty and beyond, reaching the height of its popularity in the Qing Dynasty. There are no restrictions on the themes of the paintings, and there is no blessing they cannot convey. Yangliuqing New Year Paintings are loved all over the country for their beautiful details and vivid colors—but most of all, for the good wishes they impart to anyone who sees them.

Yangliuqing New Year Paintings are loved all over the country for their beautiful details and vivid colors—but most of all, for the good wishes they impart to anyone who sees them.

programme.title: Nyingchi Ep.2
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He continues his journey through Nyingchi, Xizang Autonomous Region. He meets the Lhoba people, China’s smallest ethnic group, who show him their traditional hunting attire. At a sacred lake, Tianran visits an ancient monastery and witnesses the 3000-year-old dance of the Gongbo Tibetans, before venturing to a remote village to experience their their way of life.

programme.title: Nyingchi Ep.3
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He rounds off his travels through Nyingchi, Xizang Autonomous Region. He journeys into the Yarlung Zangbo Grand Canyon – one of the largest and deepest canyons on Earth, and along the way, tries to catch a glimpse of Mount Namcha Barwa, the easternmost peak of the Himalayas. Instead, he encounters a waterfall said to be a gateway to the afterlife, before finally arriving at the entrance to the canyon.

programme.title: Wenzhou
programme.desc: Tianran He is in Wenzhou, southeast China — a city famed for its self-made millionaires. Here he meets the first Chinese shoemaker to expand overseas, and hears the stories of other local entrepreneurs. Along the way, he samples traditional snacks, visits some of China’s oldest lighthouses, and enjoys an evening of Ou Opera. He also learns the craft of papermaking, before heading into the hills to soak in hot springs and wander across ancient covered bridges.

programme.title: Outkirts of Wenzhou
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He explores Wenzhou’s counties. programme.title: Jingmai Wanderings: A Symphony of Humans and Tea
programme.desc: As a UNESCO World Heritage site, Mount Jingmai embodies the ecological wisdom of forest–tea symbiosis and the rich cultural diversity of its ethnic communities. programme.title: Back to the Land: Exploring new life in rural China
programme.desc: When we think of the countryside, what colour comes to mind? The answer lies in Wuxin—Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal and Water—an ancient rhythm that still pulses beneath China’s landscapes.In this programme, we explore how the colours of Wuxing come to life through the traditions of China’s ethnic minority groups. From Lugu Lake’s matrilineal water world and the metal-hued fire of the Yi Torch Festival, to Dali’s earth-driven crafts, Guizhou’s wooden Dong dwellings, and the volcanic winds of Inner Mongolia’s new nomadic life—the Five Elements guide the stories of people reconnecting with land, culture and community.

programme.title: Quanzhou Nanyin: A Living Fossil in the History of Chinese Music
programme.desc: Nanyin, also known as “Quanzhou Nanyin,” is an ancient Han Chinese musical tradition whose singing style preserves the time-honored ethnic vocal techniques predating the Tang Dynasty, earning it the title of “a living fossil in the history of Chinese music.”The program features Yegor, a Ukrainian music enthusiast, visiting Master Su Shuyong, a Nanyin inheritor, to hear her decades-long stories of teaching this art. They also tour the Quanzhou Nanyin Troupe, where, led by its artistic director Zhuang Lifen, they learn about the basic performance formats and instruments of Nanyin. Additionally, the episode follows a post-1990s Nanyin performer, Zheng Mingming, as she sips tea with guests...

programme.title: The Elegance of Luoyang
programme.desc: Luoyang, as the eastern starting point of the Silk Road, is a city with a rich history and a tradition of cultural inclusivity. As such, it enjoys a prominent position in the heritage of the whole world.In this episode, we’ll visit White Horse Temple to learn about its fascinating international background. At Longmen Grottoes, which were designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in the year 2000, we’ll appreciate how the unique ancient splendor is being revived by 3D technology. At the city’s annual Peony Festival, we’ll explore the significance of China’s national flower and national dress.Invited to a Luoyang Water Banquet, we’ll learn something about the city’s culinary traditions....

programme.title: Back to the Land: Exploring new life in rural China
programme.desc: When we think of the countryside, what colour comes to mind? The answer lies in Wuxin—Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal and Water—an ancient rhythm that still pulses beneath China’s landscapes.In this programme, we explore how the colours of Wuxing come to life through the traditions of China’s ethnic minority groups. From Lugu Lake’s matrilineal water world and the metal-hued fire of the Yi Torch Festival, to Dali’s earth-driven crafts, Guizhou’s wooden Dong dwellings, and the volcanic winds of Inner Mongolia’s new nomadic life—the Five Elements guide the stories of people reconnecting with land, culture and community.

programme.title: Quanzhou Nanyin: A Living Fossil in the History of Chinese Music
programme.desc: Nanyin, also known as “Quanzhou Nanyin,” is an ancient Han Chinese musical tradition whose singing style preserves the time-honored ethnic vocal techniques predating the Tang Dynasty, earning it the title of “a living fossil in the history of Chinese music.”The program features Yegor, a Ukrainian music enthusiast, visiting Master Su Shuyong, a Nanyin inheritor, to hear her decades-long stories of teaching this art. They also tour the Quanzhou Nanyin Troupe, where, led by its artistic director Zhuang Lifen, they learn about the basic performance formats and instruments of Nanyin. Additionally, the episode follows a post-1990s Nanyin performer, Zheng Mingming, as she sips tea with guests...

programme.title: Foodwise: Beijing's Hutongs
programme.desc: The Hutongs in Beijing are considered the city's blood vessels, as these traditional alleyways make up the DNA of the capital for its rich history and culture.In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May zigzag their way through the Hutongs and the Forbidden City for a mouth-watering experience full of ancient and modern delicacies. Starring German designer Katrin, Russian artist Liuba and photographer Feng Yu from Beijing, our hosts are taking you along a journey that features fried noodles, dim sum, pancakes and co.!

programme.title: Foodwise：Eating Global in Beijing
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May are in search of global cuisines that can be found in Beijing, the 3000-year old capital of China. From honest farm-to-table fare, to the culinary heights of French haute cuisine, and even a cooking class and wine and dine event at a traditional courtyard home in the city center, we'll discover that in Beijing, you can taste the world.

programme.title: Foodwise: Quanzhou
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May are in Quanzhou, the ancient starting point of the Maritime Silk Road. From its covered arcades and Roman columns to its Southeast Asian vibe, our hosts discover that Quanzhou truly is a melting pot of world cultures. Then there’s the food: From the local noodle porridge that utilizes Silk Road spices, to fried vinegar pork and a dessert made from a special algae, there’s plenty of unique dishes to try here. Over a cup of oolong, our hosts will discover how Quanzhou’s tea changed the world, and how trade with Arab civilizations influenced a local fishing village. So join us in Quanzhou, a city that UNESCO designated as an “Emporium of the World”!

programme.title: Foodwise: Datong
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Angela Fu are in historic Datong. Located in northern China's Shanxi Province, some 1500 years ago Datong was the capital of the Northern Wei Dynasty, which saw nomads unite northern China and Buddhism spread throughout the country. At the renowned Yungang Grottoes where giant Buddhas were carved out of cliffs, our hosts discover Datong's multicultural past and sample the emperor's favorite cake. They seek out the remains of a Jesuit church beneath the Great Wall of China, and find in the local cuisine elements that echo the past, and modern-day recipes for thousand-year old dishes.

programme.title: Foodwise: Chaozhou
programme.desc: In this episode, hosts Tianran He and Angela Fu are in Chaozhou, South China. They're on a quest to discover the secrets of its success, for Chaozhou is famed for its wealthy merchant guilds and its homegrown Teochew cuisine, which enjoys global recognition.From working as part-timers in a beef hotpot restaurant, to learning about tea ceremony and shadowing a master of Teochew cuisine, our hosts discover the best way to learn about Chaozhou, is through its food.

programme.title: Culture Forward
programme.desc: Culture Forward is set at a pivotal moment between the close of China’s 14th Five-Year Plan and the launch of the 15th. The program explores how technology is giving culture new momentum, featuring cases such as Guizhou’s mechanized batik techniques, the digital presentation of Liangzhu culture, AI-powered design for Miao embroidery, and creative innovation at the Hunan Museum. Through real-world practices, it reveals how traditional Chinese culture is being revitalized in the age of intelligence—moving toward a future that is more open, innovative, and high-quality.

The program explores how technology is giving culture new momentum, featuring cases such as Guizhou’s mechanized batik techniques, the digital presentation of Liangzhu culture, AI-powered design for Miao embroidery, and creative innovation at the Hunan Museum. Through real-world practices, it reveals how traditional Chinese culture is being revitalized in the age of intelligence—moving toward a future that is more open, innovative, and high-quality.

programme.title: Awakening Lion
programme.desc: Xingshi, or literally “awakened lion,” is a name for the southern style of the lion dance. Historically, it evolved from a court dance in the Tang Dynasty almost 1,200 years ago. With the southward migration of the population from the central plains, lion dance culture was introduced to the south. In the Ming Dynasty around 400 years ago, xingshi appeared in Guangdong and was then widely spread throughout southern China and even overseas. Lion dance has become a very important part of Chinese culture.

programme.title: The Story of Flying Trident
programme.desc: Feicha, or a flying trident, is a type of performance where you balance a revolving trident on your body. In Chinese history, the trident was one of the 18 main weapons of war, but now it has become more of an acrobatic act. For thousands of years, people in China have practiced it as a performance and also as a way to keep fit.It seems like the trident is stuck to the person’s body like a magnet, but that effect is achieved by tensing and relaxing muscles at the right time so that the movement of the trident is channeled in the right direction—be it around the hands, neck, or back. Otherwise, its energy will turn against the performer.

programme.title: World Heritages in Handan
programme.desc: Handan, a renowned historical and cultural city in China, boasts abundant cultural and tourism resources, including the Handan Museum and Congtai Park in Congtai District, as well as the Xiangtangshan Grottoes, Guangfu Ancient City, Cizhou Kiln, etc. Handan also has a long-standing connection with the Beijing-Hangzhou Grand Canal, a world cultural heritage. As a great project created in ancient China, the Grand Canal has not only exerted a profound impact on cities along the route in terms of transportation, economy and culture, but also served as an important driving force for Handan's development.

programme.title: Foodwise：Eating Global in Beijing
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May are in search of global cuisines that can be found in Beijing, the 3000-year old capital of China. From honest farm-to-table fare, to the culinary heights of French haute cuisine, and even a cooking class and wine and dine event at a traditional courtyard home in the city center, we'll discover that in Beijing, you can taste the world.

programme.title: Foodwise: Quanzhou
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May are in Quanzhou, the ancient starting point of the Maritime Silk Road. From its covered arcades and Roman columns to its Southeast Asian vibe, our hosts discover that Quanzhou truly is a melting pot of world cultures. Then there’s the food: From the local noodle porridge that utilizes Silk Road spices, to fried vinegar pork and a dessert made from a special algae, there’s plenty of unique dishes to try here. Over a cup of oolong, our hosts will discover how Quanzhou’s tea changed the world, and how trade with Arab civilizations influenced a local fishing village. So join us in Quanzhou, a city that UNESCO designated as an “Emporium of the World”!

programme.title: Foodwise: Datong
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Angela Fu are in historic Datong. Located in northern China's Shanxi Province, some 1500 years ago Datong was the capital of the Northern Wei Dynasty, which saw nomads unite northern China and Buddhism spread throughout the country. At the renowned Yungang Grottoes where giant Buddhas were carved out of cliffs, our hosts discover Datong's multicultural past and sample the emperor's favorite cake. They seek out the remains of a Jesuit church beneath the Great Wall of China, and find in the local cuisine elements that echo the past, and modern-day recipes for thousand-year old dishes.

Her adventure will lead her through the Libourne region, then onwards to the North of France, the Ardèche, and the Aisne, where bakers have transformed bread into a powerful catalyst for social cohesion. While some individuals may avoid bread, particularly due to gluten-related concerns, others have chosen to reposition it at the forefront of the dining experience by championing its nutritional benefits. This commitment is shared by several chefs whom Julie will meet at the conclusion of her expedition.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Juliette (Morbihan)
programme.desc: Juliette has long been aware of the delicate beauty of nature. For years she spent her life on the sea, organising regattas for the traditional sailboats that are famous in the French region of Morbihan. Her appreciation for the elements made for a smooth transition as she decided to leave the water behind and return to the earth. Learning to shape a ball of clay into a graceful and elegant object, she discovered a passion for ceramics. Today, she lives from her creations and makes pieces that reflect their surroundings, the stunning Gulf of Morbihan.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Anna (Brittany)
programme.desc: Anna’s unusual background provided inspiration for her life change. Her career began as a wolf trainer for cinema and it was during these years that she developed her deep love for animals. After being tired of seeing them used as props and constantly in cages, she decided to leave the world of show business behind and start an eco-friendly sheep and goat pasture. To further share her passion for these gentle animals, Anna has opened a conservatory farm where visitors can experience first-hand the joys of being close to nature. She also makes amazing goat cheese!

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Cristina (Spain)
programme.desc: At 31 years old, the last thing Cristina expected when she went to see the doctor about a blocked ear was to leave the consultation with a diagnosis for Breast Cancer. This young and passionate sociologist decided to apply the same philosophy to her treatment as she did when surfing: when a wave crashes down on you, get up and try again. Through her healing journey she deepened her love for the ocean and also discovered the therapeutic capabilities of yoga for cancer patients. Today she shares her practice through surf and yoga retreats and is specialised in oncological yoga, helping others heal.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Idoia (Spain)
programme.desc: Idoia thrives on weaving together the sources of inspiration that surround her. Heavily influenced by the natural beauty of her home region of Galicia, Spain, she creates unique woven pieces from diverse and beautiful materials. Idoia’s pieces represent her vision of a modern woman, drawing from the traditions and experiences of those who perfected the craft before her and also pushing to innovate and adapt her creations for the modern world. Her recent collaboration with luxury fashion house Loewe is a dream come true for this modern artisan.

Julie Andersen, an ex-advertising executive from New York has come to South Africa to defend sharks with her Shark Angels Foundation. In North India, Kartik Satyanarayan is helping to stop the dreadful exploitation of the lippus bears (dancing bears). programme.desc: "The end of oil" is the amazing story of a raw material which has revolutionized man's life in just a century. But today, oil reserves are depleting. To tell the adventure of oil, Yann Arthus-Bertrand and his team went to the United States, the country which depends the most on black gold. At the start of the 21st century, it is now urgent to realize that oil resources are limited. It's today that we have to act and get organized, in order to prepare the new era to come. programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 A la carte grills
programme.desc: If you're a nature enthusiast and a fan of outdoor cooking, the upcoming season is perfect for barbecue enthusiasts! Our journey will take us to Aube, nestled in the heart of the Brévonnes forest, and then to the Massif des Bauges, where grilling and snow create a unique combination. Afterward, we'll explore the Libournais region, where we'll uncover cooking techniques that make use of vine shoots, which are plentiful in the area. Just a short distance from the vineyards, we'll arrive at another corner of Gironde, the Blaye region, where the cooking method remains consistent but features a distinctly local ingredient: eel.

programme.title: My Zen Family - Season 1 - Last preps

Coralie and Florent are still walking on clouds as they wait for their daughter, Lena. So are Nathalie and Naoufel, who arrange a tour of the future baby’s bedroom. Things are still tense between Kim and her parents. Her father blames here for having left school too early and the family makes no effort to hide their dislike of Pierre, the would-be father, who is still a no-show. They go as far as opposing Kim’s preferred choice for the future boy’s name, since it was his father that came up with the idea...

programme.title: My Zen Family - Season 1 - Welcome in a new world

In the end, it is Nathalie and Naoufel, our most experienced parents, who share with us some words of wisdom: “one isn’t just born being a parent, one has to learn it.”
